$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package anyparse.check.facts. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-FACTS-CALL-TARGET
arms.note: a field call is written without its target, so an abstract operator or an accessor is a call of nothing

arms.name: M-FACTS-SUPER
arms.note: a super call names no constructor, so the implicit constructor reaches nothing

arms.name: M-FACTS-INITIALIZER
arms.note: a field initializer is written as a method node

arms.name: M-FACTS-ITER
arms.note: a kept for loop records no iteration

arms.name: M-FACTS-STRING-OPERAND
arms.note: a non-String operand of a concatenation is not recorded

arms.name: M-FACTS-LOCAL-CALL
arms.note: a local function is not remembered, so its call is a call of a value

arms.name: M-FACTS-FIELD-WRITE
arms.note: an assigned field is recorded as read, never written

arms.name: M-FACTS-REFLECT-NAME
arms.note: a reflected literal name is dropped, so every reflection site reads as computed

arms.name: M-FACTS-NATIVE
arms.note: a Syntax.code call is no native site

arms.name: M-FACTS-FLOW-CAST
arms.note: an unchecked cast carries no flow

arms.name: M-FACTS-TYPE-PARAMETER
arms.note: a type parameter prints as a class path

arms.name: M-FACTS-INLINE-POSITIONS
arms.note: an inlined body takes the call site's range, so its facts read as the type of the call

arms.name: M-FACTS-READS
arms.note: a local read records no type

arms.name: M-FACTS-BRANCH-LEAVES
arms.note: a branching value flows once, at the type its branches unify to

arms.name: M-FACTS-MONO-SINK
arms.note: a place of no type stays unknown instead of Dynamic

arms.name: M-FACTS-CAST-ALWAYS
arms.note: an unchecked cast between equal types records no source

arms.name: M-FACTS-THROW
arms.note: a thrown value reaches no place

arms.name: M-FACTS-UNTYPED-ARGS
arms.note: an argument of a callee with no function type reaches no place

arms.name: M-FACTS-REST
arms.note: rest arguments flow into the rest type itself or nowhere

arms.name: M-FACTS-GENERIC
arms.replace: case KGenericInstance(_, _), KTypeParameter(_), KMacroType, KGenericBuild, KExpr(_):
arms.note: a @:generic instance is skipped

arms.name: M-FACTS-INIT
arms.note: __init__ is not walked

arms.name: M-FACTS-REASSIGNED-LOCAL
arms.note: a reassigned local is read as one fixed function

arms.name: M-FACTS-FIELD-VALUE
arms.note: a call of a field value names the field as a fixed body

arms.name: M-FACTS-REFLECTION-INLINED
arms.note: an inlined Reflect call leaves no mark

arms.name: M-FACTS-OVERLOADS
arms.note: overload bodies past the first are not walked

arms.name: M-FACTS-INLINED-CHILD
arms.note: a function spliced in from another body claims a range of the file it was declared in

arms.name: M-FACTS-GENERATED
arms.note: a macro-built body claims a range of the macro file

arms.name: M-FACTS-DROPPED
arms.note: a configuration that failed is dropped in silence

arms.name: M-FACTS-INLINED-CALL
arms.note: an inlined call leaves no call fact

arms.name: M-FACTS-SAME-FILE-INLINE
arms.find: final inside: Bool = info.file == _home && info.min >= _min && info.max <= _max;
arms.note: a body inlined from the same file reads as the caller's own code

arms.name: M-FACTS-MACRO-EXPANSION
arms.note: a macro expansion leaves no mark

arms.name: M-FACTS-REFLECT-VALUE
arms.note: a reflection member read as a value is no reflection site

arms.name: M-FACTS-UNTYPED-DECLARED
arms.note: an untyped-retyped value flows at its retyped type

arms.name: M-FACTS-IDENT-READ
arms.note: a native identifier read is no native site

arms.name: M-FACTS-BUILDS
arms.note: a build macro is not recorded

arms.name: M-FACTS-REFLECTION-PATH
arms.note: any Type.hx or Reflect.hx counts as the std reflection

arms.name: M-FACTS-SPLICE-SITE
arms.note: an inlined call records no site, so all it spliced in may run anywhere in its caller

arms.name: M-FACTS-SPLICE-SITE-INNERMOST
arms.note: (precision) an inlined call ran anywhere in its caller's body, not in the innermost expression around its call site

arms.name: M-FACTS-SPLICE-BODY
arms.note: an inlined call records no declared range, so nothing it spliced in is attributed to it

arms.name: M-FACTS-NESTED-SPLICE
arms.note: a body a spliced body spliced in turn is no call of its own: its code is attributed to no call, or to a call of it elsewhere

arms.name: M-FACTS-EXPANSION-RECORDED
arms.note: an expansion the body's own code holds is recorded nowhere, so the code it built is attributed to no call the text writes

arms.name: M-FACTS-EXPANSION-NESTED
arms.note: an expansion an inlined method's code holds is recorded nowhere, so the code it built is attributed to no call the text writes

arms.name: M-FACTS-MACRO-CALLEE
arms.note: no macro method is known where it is declared, so no expansion is matched to the macro that built it

arms.name: M-FACTS-CALL-SITE-INLINE
arms.note: only an `inline` method is matched to a splice, so a method its call site inlines reads as a macro expansion

arms.name: M-FACTS-SPLICE-OWN-ARGUMENTS
arms.note: a spliced body's own call-site arguments are searched for the method it came from, so a macro expansion is read as an inlined call of the caller itself

arms.name: M-FACTS-ABSTRACT-THIS
arms.find: final straddles: Bool = !inside && info.file == _home && info.min <= _max && info.max >= _min;
arms.note: a range meeting the body without lying inside it — an abstract method's own `this`, placed at the whole abstract — reads as a splice, and the method is marked as a macro expansion

arms.name: M-FACTS-ELEMENT-WRITE
arms.note: an element write leaves no fact, so an array written through its elements reads as never mutated

arms.name: M-FACTS-USE
arms.note: every field read is used as a value, so no read says it only calls, indexes or compares

arms.name: M-FACTS-HELD
arms.note: a field read held in a local is no longer followed through the local's reads, so a lowered loop's array reads as escaping

arms.name: M-FACTS-CAPTURE
arms.note: a local read from a nested function keeps its own use, so a captured field value reads as used in place

arms.name: M-FACTS-FRESH
arms.note: no field write is fresh, so a member only ever reset to a new array reads as holding a shared one

arms.name: M-FACTS-FRESH-DISCARDED
arms.note: a fresh value stored by an assignment used as a value counts as the field's alone, though the assignment hands it on

arms.name: M-FACTS-INLINED-RECEIVER
arms.find: final called: Null<String> = receiverCall(v, e.pos, block);
arms.note: the receiver of an inlined method is held in the compiler's local like any value, so the key-value loop's array reads as handed to `new ArrayKeyValueIterator` and escapes

arms.name: M-FACTS-RECEIVER-BLOCK
arms.find: return at.file != around.file || at.min != around.min || at.max != around.max
arms.note: a local the inlined method's own code names `_this` counts as the compiler's receiver binding, so an argument it keeps reads as the receiver of a call of the array's own method

arms.name: M-FACTS-RECEIVER-PARAM
arms.note: a parameter named `_this`, bound by the compiler as it binds a receiver, counts as the receiver, so the argument it keeps reads as the receiver of a call of the array's own method

arms.name: M-FACTS-THROW-TEXT
arms.note: a thrown value is recorded as converted to no string, though the exception wrapping hands it to `Std.string`

arms.name: M-FACTS-HANDS
arms.note: an argument handed to target code is recorded nowhere, so a value an extern keeps never escapes

arms.name: M-FACTS-GENS
arms.note: the instantiation of a generic method is recorded nowhere, so what its type parameters stand for is never known

arms.name: M-FACTS-STRING-EXACT
arms.note: no converted value is an object of exactly its own class, so a fresh one runs the conversion of whatever its type may hold

arms.name: M-FACTS-EXACT-WRITTEN
arms.note: a local initialized with a construction is taken to hold it even after it is written again

arms.name: M-FACTS-THROW-EXCEPTION
arms.note: a thrown exception of exactly its class is recorded as converted to a string, though the wrapping throws it as it is

arms.name: M-FACTS-ALIAS-TYPEDEF
arms.note: an import alias, which no module lists, gets no record, so a type naming it names no type the table holds

arms.name: M-FACTS-STATICS-TYPEDEF
arms.note: the typedef of an enum's statics is printed with arguments after its name (`Enum<pack.E><?>`), which the type grammar does not read

arms.name: M-FACTS-FLOW-EXACT
arms.note: the exactness of a value flowing whole is recorded nowhere

arms.name: M-RUNMEMO-NO-BASELINE-AHEAD
arms.note: the facts compile no longer brings the baseline along, so the baseline asked next is a compile of its own

arms.name: M-FACTS-EARLY-DIRS-LEFT
arms.note: facts compiles no check asked for leave their probe directories behind

arms.name: M-FACTS-ORACLE-AGREE
arms.note: the first of two types the configurations disagree on is answered, so an annotation is right in one build and wrong in the other

arms.name: M-FACTS-ORACLE-RAW-AGREE
arms.note: the first of the types the facts give a value at its range is its type, though the configurations disagree

arms.name: M-FACTS-SPELL-UNKNOWN
arms.note: an unbound monomorph is spelled Dynamic, so a type the compiler never pinned is written as one

arms.name: M-FACTS-SPELL-SCOPE
arms.note: every type parameter is in scope, so a parameter of another declaration is written where it names nothing

arms.name: M-FACTS-SPELL-IMPL
arms.note: an abstract's statics and implementation class are spelled like any path, which no source can write

arms.name: M-FACTS-DYNAMIC-SOURCE
arms.note: a local a Dynamic value initializes is annotated with the structure its uses bound, which the value need not have

arms.name: M-ORACLE-WHOLE-MEMBER
find:
case Mapped(at) if (site.text.substring(at.from, at.to) == site.current.substring(member.from, member.to)):
				query(site, new Span(key.from + at.from - member.from, key.to + at.from - member.from), here);
arms.note: only the declaration's name is placed, so an edit elsewhere in its member — a changed signature the inferred type rests on — goes unseen

arms.name: M-ORACLE-HOME-GUARD
arms.note: facts of any member answer for code the file now holds in another

arms.name: M-ORACLE-HOME-MODIFIED-TYPE
arms.note: a `final class` names no type, so every declaration in one reads as homeless and declines

arms.name: M-FACTS-WRITTEN-DURING
arms.note: a file written while the facts compile ran is certified by a hash of the text it has now

arms.name: M-FACTS-VALUE-TYPE-FLOWS
arms.find: final spelled: String = switch valueType(file, expr) {
arms.replace: final spelled: String = switch expressionType(file, expr) {
arms.note: a value's type is read with the flows at its range, so a check-type `(e : T)` answers the type of `e`, not `T`

arms.name: M-UNUSED-PRIVATE-CHAIN-DECLARED
arms.note: a member a supertype declares, an abstract one's implementation among them, is deleted

arms.name: M-UNUSED-PRIVATE-CHAIN-AUTOBUILD
arms.note: a member of a class a supertype's `@:autoBuild` builds is deleted

arms.name: M-FACTS-ESCAPE-SHIFT
arms.note: an expression in a string after an escape is typed by the fact the compiler shifted onto its range

arms.name: M-FOLD-FACTS-PLAIN-KINDS
arms.find: return id != null && (builtins.contains(id) || (declared != null && declared.alike && PLAIN_KINDS.contains(declared.kind)))
arms.note: any type the facts name is named, an abstract included, and the overload table judges another declaration of that simple name

arms.name: M-FACTS-ALIKE-FOLD
arms.note: a type one configuration declares a class and another an overloading abstract is named by the first one's record

arms.name: M-FACTS-FIXED-LOOP-ANY
arms.note: every loop binder counts as fixed, so one over a local or a generic call a later call typed is rewritten and no longer compiles

arms.name: M-FACTS-CTOR-EVERY
arms.note: a constructor of the name typed by an enum parameter is ignored once another is closed, so the name alone decides which enum the pattern is of

arms.name: M-FACTS-CTOR-ARITY
arms.find:
case Named(_, _):
					case Function(args, _) if (index >= args.length):
arms.note: a same-named constructor taking no argument, or fewer, refuses the capture though a pattern with that argument cannot be of it

arms.name: M-FACTS-WALK-WRITTEN-CONSTANT
arms.note: an inlined method of which the compiler kept only the constants it wrote as another inline call's arguments is no splice

arms.name: M-FACTS-WALK-JOINED-START
arms.note: a field read the compiler joined across two methods' code records no splice of the method writing the field

arms.name: M-FACTS-CALL-OPERAND
arms.note: a call handing a value to a `Dynamic` parameter records none of it, so a conversion an inlined body spliced in from another file converts a value of any type (the client's `StringBuf.add` in `EReg.replace`)

arms.name: M-FACTS-CALL-OPERAND-LEAF
arms.note: the first leaf of a value handed to a `Dynamic` parameter is the value, so `Std.string(c ? new Plain() : d)` converts a `Plain` only

arms.name: M-FACTS-CALL-OPERAND-EXACT
arms.note: the exactness of a value handed to a `Dynamic` parameter is recorded nowhere

arms.name: M-FACTS-REFL-RECEIVER
arms.note: a reflective call records nothing of the object it acts on, so every access by a computed name may reach any member

arms.name: M-FACTS-REFL-SELF
arms.note: (precision) `this` handed to a reflective call is any object of its type, an escaped instance of another type included

arms.name: M-FACTS-REFL-EXACT
arms.note: (precision) an object built of exactly its class and handed to a reflective call may be an instance of a subclass

arms.name: M-FACTS-NATIVE-CODE
arms.note: a native call records no text, so the code it pastes names nothing

arms.name: M-FACTS-CODE-META
arms.note: the target code a metadata pastes is recorded nowhere

arms.name: M-FACTS-NATIVE-HANDED
arms.note: a native site records no value a call of it hands its target code

arms.name: M-FACTS-NATIVE-CHAIN
arms.note: a field chain rooted at a native identifier is recorded as the bare identifier: no text, nothing handed

arms.name: M-FACTS-WALK-BLOCK-GAP
arms.note: a statement a splice or an expansion replaced is placed at its whole block

arms.name: M-FACTS-SITE-HOLDS-OWN-CODE
arms.note: a splice is placed between the statements around it although a statement the compiler bound at the whole block bounds it: the site holds none of the call's text, so an expression macro in its arguments reads as no text's call

arms.name: M-FACTS-REFL-FRESH
arms.note: (precision) an object literal handed to a reflective call is recorded as any value of its type

arms.name: M-FACTS-REFL-FRESH-LOCAL
arms.note: (precision) a local initialized with an object literal holds any value of its type

arms.name: M-FACTS-REFL-FRESH-WRITTEN
arms.note: a local initialized with an object literal holds that structure even after code assigns it another value

arms.name: M-FACTS-REFL-FRESH-ANY
arms.note: any expression handed to a reflective call — a field of a literal another write may replace, a call — is a structure the code built

arms.name: M-FACTS-GENERIC-RECORDED
arms.note: a construction is written without the `@:genericBuild` class its text constructs

arms.name: M-FACTS-GENERIC-BUILT
arms.note: a `@:genericBuild` class the text names is recorded whatever class its build at the text's type arguments resolves to: a build macro that constructs another class there leaves its type its text

arms.name: M-FACTS-ROUNDS
arms.note: each round of the hook rewrites the facts file with only the types defined since the last: a type a `@:genericBuild` asked again defines leaves the facts of that one type

arms.name: M-FACTS-SPLICED-REFLECTION-FROM
arms.note: (precision) the facts never name the method a spliced reflective fact lies in, so no such body is read

arms.name: M-FACTS-ASSIGN-HELD
arms.note: a field's value an assignment statement stores in a local is used as a value, so a local assigned in branches reads as an escape

arms.name: M-FACTS-ASSIGNED-NO-USE
arms.note: a write of a local holding the value is a use of it as a value, so every assigned local escapes

arms.name: M-FACTS-ASSIGNED-TARGET
arms.note: the local an assignment writes is walked as a read used as a value, so every assigned local escapes

arms.name: M-FACTS-ALIAS-LINK
arms.note: a local stored in another local is used as a value, so its reads through the second local are never followed

arms.name: M-FACTS-HELD-LOCAL
arms.note: a local initialized with another local is walked as a value, so the first local's value escapes there

arms.name: M-FACTS-SUBSTITUTED-RECEIVER
arms.note: a local an inline method of no parameter was spliced in with is used as that method's code uses it, so a key-value loop over a local hands it to `new ArrayKeyValueIterator`

arms.name: M-FACTS-SUBSTITUTED-ARITY
arms.note: a local spliced into an inline method's body as an argument is taken for its receiver, a call of that method

arms.name: M-FACTS-SUBSTITUTED-OWNER
arms.find: case TInst(c, _) if (TypedFactsTypeStrings.typeId(c.get().pack, c.get().name) == substituted.id.substr(0, dot)): name;
arms.note: a local spliced into an inline method of another class than its own is taken for that method's receiver

arms.name: M-FACTS-ASSIGN-STATEMENT
arms.note: an assignment whose own value goes on still stores the value only in its local, so `keep(l = items)` hands nothing on

arms.name: M-FACTS-ASSIGN-OWNER
arms.note: a store into a local of an enclosing function is followed through the reads that function made so far, never the later ones

arms.name: M-FACTS-HELD-FLAG
arms.note: a field read held in a local no longer says so, so the touch through the local is placed at the store

arms.name: M-FACTS-HELD-THROUGH-IF
arms.note: a field read in a branch of an if-expression (a ternary is one) initializing or assigned to a local is a value read again, so `final l = if (c) items else null;` escapes where `l = items;` in a branch of a statement `if` is followed

arms.name: M-FACTS-HELD-THROUGH-SWITCH
arms.find: for (c in cases) held = held || heldValue(c.expr);
arms.note: a field read in an arm of a switch-expression initializing a local is a value read again, so the local's value escapes there

arms.name: M-FACTS-HELD-THROUGH-PAREN
arms.note: a parenthesised field read initializing a local is a value read, so `var l = (items);` escapes where `var l = items;` is followed

arms.name: M-FACTS-HELD-THROUGH-BLOCK
arms.note: the block the typer wraps each branch of an if- or switch-expression in hands nothing on, so every such branch read is a value read again

arms.name: M-FACTS-HELD-THROUGH-TRY
arms.note: a field read as the body of a try-expression initializing a local is a value read again, so the local's value escapes there

arms.name: M-FACTS-ASSIGN-HELD-THROUGH
arms.note: an assignment statement storing an if-expression whose branch reads a field is no store of that value any more, so `l = if (c) items else null;` escapes where the declaration form is followed

arms.name: M-FACTS-KEPT-DEFAULT
arms.note: (soundness) a parameter a default value replaces a null for is recorded as holding what each call hands it

arms.name: M-FACTS-KEPT-WRITTEN
arms.note: (soundness) a parameter the body assigns is recorded as holding what each call hands it

arms.name: M-FACTS-FRESH-MAP
arms.note: (precision) a `new Map()` stored by an assignment is not recorded as held by its target alone

arms.name: M-FACTS-IDENTITY-CAST-VALUE
arms.note: a value read through a cast to the type it already has is a plain value under it, so a Map handed to a method that only iterates it escapes in the facts and keeps its key

arms.name: M-FACTS-ARGUMENT-USE
arms.note: an argument of a declared method is recorded as a plain value, so no read names the parameter it is handed to and every argument escapes again

arms.name: M-FACTS-PARAM-ALIAS
arms.note: a parameter is no local of its node, so its reads record no use and every method reads as keeping nothing of what it is handed — a store into a static among them

arms.name: M-FACTS-ARGUMENT-CAST
arms.note: an argument the compiler casts (a Map handed to an Iterable) is a plain value under the cast, so passing a map to Lambda.count escapes again

arms.name: M-FACTS-ABSTRACT-WRAPPED-CAST
arms.note: a local spliced into an inlined abstract method as its this is cast from the abstract to the type it wraps, and that cast hands the value on, so a Map parameter a method only iterates escapes

arms.name: M-FACTS-REFL-MEMBER-NAME
arms.note: (precision) a reflective call records no member its name argument names by a literal

arms.name: M-FACTS-REFL-MEMBER-NAME-ANY
arms.note: the member a reflective call names is its last argument's literal: the value `setField` stores

arms.name: M-FACTS-REFL-MEMBER-NAME-TABLE
arms.note: every reflective call names a member by its second argument: `Type.createEnum`'s constructor name too

arms.name: M-FACTS-READ-EMIT-NAME
arms.note: a local read records no name, so no read is the text's own

arms.name: M-RIDDEN-NO-RERUN
arms.note: the facts of a build of several arms are read off the shared compile, which gives the command-line defines to every arm where the plain facts compile gives them to the first

arms.name: M-RIDDEN-NO-HOOK-DEFINES
arms.note: the shared compile types without keep-inline-positions, so an inlined body's facts take the call site's range where the plain facts compile keeps the callee's
